svg.text: news + social + filings → trained NLP risk signal → deterministic, portfolio-aware stress test → dashboard. Module B (stress) and Module A (index rebalancer) both read the signal. Numbers 1-8: the order a report takes.
poll. Live is OFF at every start
gradient boosting on market state + event calendar + TF-IDF event probabilities; rank-calibrated
to 1-10 with an empirical interval; labelled placeholder rule where it cannot score
every stage records model id, artifact sha256, origin; a PARTIAL signal never gets an invented
score (domain/ Pydantic contracts; models/ artifacts integrity-checked at load)
Side-cars (derived on read, never stored on the signal)
assessment (severity-v2 scorecard, LLM optional) · intelligence · analogues · propagation ·
monitor / watchlists / review / brief (decision intelligence) · external markets (observation only)
entities, book, e5 vectors, market context,
No SQL / DuckDB in the MVP: files and
by asset class, issuer, sector, risk
portfolio/: resolver, atomic file store, exposure chain, comparison;
used only when a request carries portfolio_id; default stays the synthetic book
no scenario reaches a position -> NOT_APPLICABLE, never a zero P&L;
uncovered exposure is listed, not treated as safe
signals · assessment · intelligence · propagation · analogues · scenarios · stress-test ·
portfolios · rebalancer · monitor · watchlists · lab · review · evidence · models · live
typed contracts shared with the UI (make types)
Stress service: the only door to the engine
trigger rule severity >= 7 (a product rule), severity scaling clamp(I/7, 0.5, 1.5),
run id = hash of inputs (same request -> same result), audit block with the origin of the score
valid stress request -> 200 + status (COMPLETED, NOT_TRIGGERED, NO_SCENARIO,
NOT_APPLICABLE, UNAVAILABLE); 404 unknown id; 422 invalid input
configs/*.yaml validated by strict Pydantic models; EVENTSHOCK_* env; keys only from the
environment or the git-ignored .env; the language model is OFF unless EVENTSHOCK_LLM=1
Desk: wire traced from news to book
map; index weights over time; severity
with Why? and provenance; timeline of
what was known when; model evidence
MODULE A: TACTICAL INDEX REBALANCER (Stage 16; a derived side-car, nothing imports it)
15 stocks, equal-weight benchmark; one source, one vote;
36 h decay, shrunk score S in [-1, 1], exponential tilt,
bounds, 4 % turnover cap; self-checked every cycle
constraint ladder names the rule that bound each stock;
approval ledger: append-only, hash-chained, 409 on a
changed proposal; nothing is sent anywhere
+0.19 % vs equal weight, 82nd placebo percentile: within chance,
so no skill is claimed. Reads only sentiment.score of the
RiskSignal; severity and impact are not inputs.
Cross-cutting: fail loudly (a modified artifact or snapshot file stops start-up; no silent fallback) · deterministic replay (fixed clock, content-derived ids, pinned digests) ·
four kinds of number never blurred (model prediction, historical observation, scenario assumption, realised outcome).
